subject.title: [Bug]: Session tables corrupt Unicode keys at truncation boundaries

question: Should the protected `maintainer` routing be cleared or sponsored so the small session-table Unicode formatter fix can proceed?
rationale: The root cause and fix boundary are clear, but the protected label prevents ClawSweeper from auto-closing or queueing repair work without maintainer handling.

options.title: Fix the shared formatter now
options.body: Update `truncateSessionKey` to slice both retained segments with `sliceUtf16Safe` and add focused table-output regression tests.

options.title: Defer the display-only bug
options.body: Leave the issue open with the protected label until a maintainer wants to spend review time on this low-severity CLI display fix.

recommendation.title: Fix the shared formatter now
recommendation.body: Update `truncateSessionKey` to slice both retained segments with `sliceUtf16Safe` and add focused table-output regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` introduced and is assigned to the affected formatter path, so they are the clearest routing owner for the protected-label decision.
